source: Original open-source projects and two existing PixelArcade local builds

games.name: Hextris
games.help: The original open-source Hextris. Rotate the hexagon and match coloured blocks.
Original open-source 2048. Use arrows or swipe to merge tiles. Best score saves in this browser.

games.name: Snakes
games.help: Original JavaScript Snakes minimal demo. Space to start and arrow keys to steer.

games.name: Tetris
games.help: Original JavaScript Tetris by Jake Gordon. Press Space to start, use the arrow keys to move pieces.

games.name: Breakout
games.help: MIT-licensed HTML5 Breakout. Paddle controls support mouse, keyboard, touch and gamepad.

games.name: Tiny Platformer
games.help: Original JavaScript platformer. Move with Left and Right, jump with Space and collect gold.

games.name: Slope
games.help: Existing self-hosted Slope game. Steer the ball while avoiding the edges.

games.name: Quake II (engine)
games.help: Open-source Quake II browser engine. Supply your own legally obtained pak0.pak game data to play.
